윷판의 칸은 1~27번이다. 말은 판 밖에서 출발하고, 판 밖의 말은 1: The spaces on the yut board are numbered 1 to 27. Pieces start off the board, and a piece off the board counts from space 1 (if do comes up, it stops on space 1). The outer path goes in the order 1→2→…→19→20. Shortcuts: a piece that starts its move from space 5 goes 5→21→22→23→24→25→20, and a piece that starts its move from space 10 goes 10→26→27→23→24→25→20. A piece that only passes through space 5 or space 10 keeps going along the outer path. A piece on spaces 21 to 27 moves toward space 20 along the shortcut that its space is on. A piece moves 1 space on do, 2 spaces on gae, 3 spaces on geol, 4 spaces on yut, and 5 spaces on mo. If a piece moves far enough to go past space 20, that piece leaves the board (goes out). If it arrives exactly on space 20, it stops on space 20. A piece stopped on space 20 goes out no matter what comes up next. If an opponent's piece is on the space where a piece finishes its move, it captures that opponent's piece. A captured piece goes back off the board.

The spaces on the yut board are numbered 1 to 27. Pieces start off the board, and a piece off the board counts from space 1 (if do comes up, it stops on space 1). The outer path goes in the order 1→2→…→19→20. Even if a piece starts its move from space 5 or space 10, it does not enter a shortcut and keeps going along the outer path. A piece already on spaces 21 to 27 moves toward space 20 along the shortcut that its space is on (5→21→22→23→24→25→20, 10→26→27→23→24→25→20). A piece moves 1 space on do, 2 spaces on gae, 3 spaces on geol, 4 spaces on yut, and 5 spaces on mo. If a piece moves far enough to go past space 20, that piece leaves the board (goes out). If it arrives exactly on space 20, it stops on space 20. A piece stopped on space 20 goes out no matter what comes up next. If an opponent's piece is on the space where a piece finishes its move, it captures that opponent's piece. A captured piece goes back off the board.
